title: 第10章
content_zh:
李巍感觉夏真钰已经做好了准备，而且在水中也能缓解疼痛，他也很心疼每次夏真钰受的罪，可是自己也无能为力。
夏真钰双手环上李巍的颈项，身体已经完全准备好接下来的事情，紧紧的闭上了眼睛迎接接下来的疼痛，也许是水的作用，这回李巍的动作并没有让她特别难受，身体也放松了下来，吻了下李巍的嘴，笑着说：不用担心，我现在不疼。
李巍也是忍得浑身紧绷，听了夏真钰的话越发来了精神和信心，蓄力冲了进去。
夏真钰搂着躺在床上的李巍，温柔的轻握他的露在外面的手，李巍则是蒙着被浑身颤抖不已，好长时间两人都没说话，就这么呆着。
李巍慢慢掀开被子，双眼通红显然是哭过了，小声问夏真钰：真钰，你还打算和我过吗？
夏真钰轻声说道：当然，李巍我早说过了，我们是夫妻，自从和你结了婚我都是在想如何过好我们两个的日子，从没想过分开之类的事情，就是这段时间我也从没想过离开，我只想能如何帮你。
李巍听了紧紧的抱住夏真钰，但此时此刻他还是面对不了自己的妻子，他是个男人却连最基本的幸福都给不了她，他只想一个人静一静。
真钰，你今晚先在这住下吧，省得真浪费了，我出去呆会儿，你不用等我了。然后从床上起来，穿上衣服离开了房间。
夏真钰坐在床上发了会儿呆后，也换了衣服，她既不想在酒店里过夜也不想回她和李巍共同的家，她现在只想回自己家，只有在父母身边自己才能安心，才睡得着，虽然时间有些晚了不过还是决定回去，拿了包和房卡准备去退房间，站在电梯前垂着头等电梯。
夏真钰，你怎么会在这里？
夏真钰闭了下眼睛，叹了口气，无奈的抬起头对站在自己面前的人说道：周市长，真是巧，您也来这里办事啊！
作者有话要说：周一伤不起啊，非常忙碌。
昨天熬夜码了字，今天中午用吃午饭的时间校对，和同事们说自己写小说呢，结果全是嘲笑啊神马的，问我书名是什么，光光表示没敢说。
ＰＳ：其实光光自认很会写肉＼文的，不过在被晋江锁了几次章节后，不会写了、措辞无能了>0<
☆、男女之间还是不要谈友谊
办事儿？在酒店客房能办什么事儿？周瑾宇好笑的看着明显心不在焉的夏真钰，想知道为什么这么晚了她会在这里？
我不是来办事儿的，明天外市有个会要起很早我就近找个酒店住下，时间能充裕点，你呢？周瑾宇丝毫没有上次的尴尬，依然风度翩翩。
夏真钰想不出怎么回答这个问题，只能敷衍：哦，我只是有点事情，现在要走了。电梯怎么这么慢，每层都要停一下。
周瑾宇很知趣的没再追问，随即换了问题：那你现在要去哪？
这个问题夏真钰还是没办法回答，有些心烦：我可以不向周市长汇报我的个人行踪吗？

周瑾宇笑了笑根本不在意她的态度，继续说：我送你吧。
说完电梯正好到了，夏真钰说了声不麻烦了，谢谢就直接进了电梯。
到前台办退房手续时，服务小姐非常热情的请她稍等然后查阅电脑办结算，不过当时间过了快十分钟时，夏真钰有些着急了，于是问道：小姐，我想问下是有什么问题吗，不然怎么这么长时间了还没有结算好？
夏小姐，数据出了些问题我们正在紧急修复，对于耽误您宝贵的时间我们非常抱歉，请您见谅，很快就会处理好。
人家这么客气，自己也不好再多说什么，只能等了，怎么今天什么事儿都不顺呢。
不过，不对啊，夏真钰一下子反应过来了，立即追问刚才那人：你怎么知道我姓夏的？李巍订房间怎么得用他自己的名字啊，根本不会特意说她的名字啊。
服务小姐显然没想到夏真钰会想到这个，有些不知所措，没有马上回答夏真钰的问题。
是我让前台拦你一会儿的。周瑾宇走到了前台，并把一张卡递给了服务人员，服务小姐如蒙大赦般接过卡去结账了。
夏真钰看着周瑾宇的举动也不阻止，自己可不想在这和他因为谁付账争执，而是直接抢过了服务小姐递过来的账单明细，看了眼价格准备一会儿拿钱还给他。
办完了所有手续，夏真钰直接往门外走，周瑾宇紧跟在后面，到了外面夏真钰直接把钱递到周瑾宇面前，周瑾宇看着眼并没接过钱，说道：你认为我会拿你的钱？
夏真钰没心思和他玩游戏，直接说：那你认为我会用你的钱吗？
面对刺猬一样的夏真钰，周瑾宇还真有些棘手，好声好气的说：其实我也没花钱，那张卡只不过记录一下而已，而且也不是用我的名字。
他当然不用花钱了，别人巴不得能招待他周大市长呢，可自己也不想欠他人情，还是算清楚的好，可是他也没花钱，当然不会要自己钱了。
没给夏真钰纠结下去的时间，周瑾宇说道：你去哪，我送你。说完扶着夏真钰的肩往前走。
夏真钰连忙躲开，急声说道：不用了，我自己打车！
周瑾宇看夏真钰一下子躲自己老远，温和的面孔也摆不下去了，沉声说：你知不知道现在几点了？
夏真钰烦死了周瑾宇的多管闲事，要不是他现在自己已经到家了，这么没完没了的，还让不让她爸妈睡觉了，刚才自己可是打了电话回家告诉爸妈自己要回去的。
于是语气也越发不好起来：我当然知道，我是个成年人，自己会照顾好自己，周市长您还是回去早点休息吧，明天还得开会呢。
周瑾宇语气冷了下来：夏真钰你不用像防贼一样的防我，上次你已经表明了你的态度，我周瑾宇还没那么没分寸的死缠烂打，不过是你我也算认识一场，这么晚了你一个人不安全，出于朋友的关心也不能让你自己走。
这才是周瑾宇的真面目吧，什么温文尔雅、风度翩翩，骨子里根本容不得别人违抗他，根本就是心机重重、笑里藏刀，于是也冷了脸说道：周市长，感谢您的厚爱，不过您和我根本是不同世界的人，没有任何交集可言，而且我也认为男女之间最好不要谈什么友谊。还有一点我杝要郑重说明一下，我不是你想像中的那种女人！

周瑾宇被夏真钰一副油盐不进的样子气得怒极反笑：你还真是洁身自好得很，看来我周瑾宇在你眼中还真是声名狼藉。行，随你意吧！说完转身便往回走。
夏真钰终于出了口气，根本不把周瑾宇生气的态度放在心上，到了路边准备找出租车回家，夜深车少，过去几辆车都有人，好容易等来一辆开了车门刚想上车，胳膊一下被人从后面拉住，吓了一大跳，回头一看还是周瑾宇。
只见他好像没发生任何事一样的对自己和颜悦色，语气诚恳：刚才是我失礼了，这样吧，你到家给我打个电话，要不发个信息也行，你看这样好不好？
夏真钰看他这样子，自己也不能太伤人，点了点头坐进了车里，说了地址车就开走了。
周瑾宇站在原地看着出租离开，默记了下车牌号然后回了酒店。
夏真钰到了家，夏妈妈嗔怪道：这么大人了还这么丢三落四的，李巍出差，你更应该注意家里钥匙，怎么还能随手放单位了呢。还有就算和同事一起出去玩也不能这么晚回家啊，以后可不能这样了，不然你婆婆该不乐意了。
夏真钰哄她道：这不是忙得忘记了嘛。妈，周一李巍就回来了，你就这么不愿意我回来住啊。
别瞎说了，感紧洗漱一下睡吧，都几点了？
把老妈劝回卧室休息，夏真钰简单洗漱了下也回到自己的房间上＼床躺下，想了想还是给周瑾宇发个信息吧，人家怎么也是为她好，自己也不能太倔强了。
她只发了四个字：我到家了。对方很快回了：好，早点休息。
夏真钰看着简洁的回信，真不明白就这么简单一件事，刚才她和周瑾宇在吵什么，虽然李巍的事情还在困扰着，但也确实累了，没一会儿就睡着了。
周末二天李巍都不见人影，夏真钰也不想惊动别人，就随他去了。等周一上班时，刚进大厅她就感觉气氛不对，怎么说呢同事照样笑着打招呼，可就是眼神和态度说不上来的奇怪，出了什么事了？
刚想找王姐姐去问问，朱主任已经看见她了，眉开眼笑的对她说道：小夏，今天来得比平时晚了些啊，是不是车不好坐啊？
朱主任早，不是的，是我这二天没回家住，不用赶公交，所以才没提前那么早。
夏真钰不明白为什么听了自己回答，朱主任的脸笑得跟盛开的菊花儿似的，只听他又说：小夏啊，你家远这个领导们都是知道的，要是平时赶不急什么的千万别着急，这种困难大家都能理解的，最近工作累不累？
这是怎么了啊，朱主任最是势力眼的人了，两只眼睛只看上不看下，他这样反常得很啊。
没事的，朱主任我已经习惯早起了，谢谢领导的关心，工作不累，同事们都很亲切。夏真钰挑着最安全的话讲。
哈哈，那就好，不过要是真有什么困难可千万别和老大哥客气啊，无论是工作上的还是生活上的，组＼织上都会尽量帮你解决。说完想拍拍夏真钰的肩，结果手伸到一半就生硬的转回去摸了下自己的头，又笑了笑就上楼去了。
嗤！这还没怎么着呢，明路都没过呢就有人开始磕头请安了？
content_en:
Li Wei felt that Xia Zhenyu was ready, and the pain could be relieved in the water. He also felt sorry for Xia Zhenyu's suffering every time, but there was nothing he could do.
Xia Zhenyu put her hands around Li Wei's neck, and her body was completely prepared for what was coming next. She closed her eyes tightly to welcome the pain that followed. Maybe it was the effect of the water. This time, Li Wei's movements did not make her particularly uncomfortable. Her body also relaxed. She kissed Li Wei's mouth and said with a smile: Don't worry, I don't feel any pain now.
Li Wei also endured the tension all over. After listening to Xia Zhenyu's words, he became more energetic and confident, and rushed in with all his strength.
Xia Zhenyu hugged Li Wei, who was lying on the bed, and gently held his exposed hand. Li Wei was covered with blankets and trembling all over. The two of them didn't speak for a long time, just staying like this.
Li Wei slowly opened the quilt, his eyes were red, obviously he had cried, and asked Xia Zhenyu in a low voice: Zhenyu, are you still planning to live with me?
Xia Zhenyu said softly: "Of course, Li Wei, I have said it before. We are husband and wife. Ever since I got married to you, I have been thinking about how to live a good life for the two of us. I have never thought about separation or anything like that. Even during this time, I have never thought about leaving. I only think about how I can help you."
Li Wei hugged Xia Zhenyu tightly after hearing this, but at this moment he still couldn't face his wife. He was a man but he couldn't even give her the most basic happiness. He just wanted to be alone and quiet.
Zhenyu, please stay here tonight to avoid wasting your time. I'll go out for a while, so you don't have to wait for me. Then he got up from the bed, put on his clothes and left the room.
Xia Zhenyu sat on the bed for a while and changed her clothes. She neither wanted to spend the night in the hotel nor go back to the home she shared with Li Wei. She just wanted to go back to her own home now. Only when she was with her parents could she feel at ease and sleep. Although it was a little late, she decided to go back. She took her bag and room card and prepared to check out the room. She stood in front of the elevator and waited for the elevator with her head hanging down.
Xia Zhenyu, why are you here?
Xia Zhenyu closed his eyes, sighed, raised his head helplessly and said to the person standing in front of him: Mayor Zhou, what a coincidence, you are here to do business too!
The author has something to say: I can’t afford to be injured on Monday, I’m very busy.
I stayed up late yesterday to type, and today I spent my lunch time proofreading. I told my colleagues that I was writing a novel, but they all laughed at me. They asked me what the title of the book was, but they simply said that they didn’t dare to say it.

☆. It’s better not to talk about friendship between men and women
Doing something? What can you do in a hotel room? Zhou Jinyu looked at Xia Zhenyu who was obviously absent-minded in a funny way, wondering why she was here so late?
I'm not here to do errands. I have a meeting in another city tomorrow and I have to get up very early. I'll find a hotel nearby to stay at so I can have more time. How about you? Zhou Jinyu was not at all embarrassed as last time and was still personable.
Xia Zhenyu couldn't think of how to answer this question, so he could only respond perfunctorily: Oh, I just have something to do and I have to leave now. Why is the elevator so slow? It has to stop at every floor.
Zhou Jinyu knew enough not to ask any more questions, and then changed the question: Where are you going now?
Xia Zhenyu still couldn't answer this question and was a little upset: Can I not report my personal whereabouts to Mayor Zhou?
Zhou Jinyu smiled and didn't care about her attitude at all, and continued: "I'll give it to you."
After saying that the elevator arrived just in time, Xia Zhenyu said no trouble, thank you and went straight into the elevator.
When she went to the front desk to check out, the service lady asked her very enthusiastically to wait a moment and then check the computer for settlement. However, when almost ten minutes passed, Xia Zhenyu became a little anxious, so she asked: Miss, I would like to ask if there is any problem, otherwise why hasn't the settlement been completed after so long?
Miss Xia, the data is outWe are urgently fixing some problems. We are very sorry for wasting your precious time. Please forgive us and they will be solved soon.
People are so polite, and I can't say anything more. I can only wait. Why is everything going wrong today?
However, that's not right. Xia Zhenyu realized it immediately and immediately asked the person just now: How did you know that my surname is Xia? Why did Li Wei have to use his own name when booking a room? He wouldn't specifically say her name.
The service lady obviously didn't expect Xia Zhenyu to think of this. She was a little overwhelmed and did not answer Xia Zhenyu's question immediately.
I asked the front desk to stop you for a while. Zhou Jinyu walked to the front desk and handed a card to the service staff. The service lady took the card as if she had been granted amnesty and went to check out.
Xia Zhenyu didn't stop when he saw Zhou Jinyu's move. She didn't want to argue with him about who paid the bill. Instead, he directly grabbed the bill details handed over by the service lady, looked at the price, and prepared to return the money to him later.
After completing all the formalities, Xia Zhenyu walked directly out the door, followed closely by Zhou Jinyu. When outside, Xia Zhenyu handed the money directly to Zhou Jinyu. Zhou Jinyu looked at it without taking the money and said: Do you think I will take your money?
Xia Zhenyu had no intention of playing games with him and said directly: Do you think I will use your money?
Facing the hedgehog-like Xia Zhenyu, Zhou Jinyu was really in trouble. He said angrily: "Actually, I didn't spend any money. The card was just for recording, and it wasn't in my name."
Of course he didn't have to spend money. Others were eager to entertain him, Mayor Zhou Da, but he didn't want to owe him a favor, so it was better to figure it out clearly. But he didn't spend any money, so of course he wouldn't ask for his own money.
Without giving Xia Zhenyu time to struggle, Zhou Jinyu said: Wherever you go, I will take you there. After speaking, he held Xia Zhenyu's shoulders and walked forward.
Xia Zhenyu quickly dodged and said hurriedly: No, I'll take a taxi myself!
Zhou Jinyu saw Xia Zhenyu hiding away from him all of a sudden, and could no longer put on his gentle face. He said in a deep voice: Do you know what time it is now?
Xia Zhenyu was so annoyed by Zhou Jinyu's meddling. If he hadn't been home now, he wouldn't have let her parents sleep. She had just called home to tell her parents that she was going back.
Then the tone became more and more unpleasant: Of course I know that I am an adult and I will take care of myself. Mayor Zhou, you should go back and rest early. We have a meeting tomorrow.
Zhou Jinyu's tone became colder: Xia Zhenyu, you don't need to guard against me like a thief. You already made your attitude clear last time. I, Zhou Jinyu, haven't stalked you so unreasonably. It's just you and I who have known each other. It's not safe for you to be alone at this late hour, and I can't let you go by yourself out of concern for your friends.
This is Zhou Jinyu's true face, right? He is gentle and personable. He cannot tolerate others disobeying him. He is simply scheming and hiding his sword in his smile. So he said with a cold face: Mayor Zhou, thank you for your love, but you and I are from different worlds and have no intersection at all. Moreover, I also think it is best not to talk about friendship between men and women. There is another point I want to make solemnly: I am not the kind of woman you imagined!
Zhou Jinyu was so angry at Xia Zhenyu's aloof appearance that he laughed: You are really clean and self-sufficient. It seems that I, Zhou Jinyu, am really notorious in your eyes. Okay, whatever you want! After saying that, he turned around and walked back.
Xia Zhenyu finally took a breath and didn't take Zhou Jinyu's angry attitude to heart at all. When he got to the roadside, he was about to find a taxi to go home. There were few cars at night and the past few cars were full of people. Finally, a car door opened and he was about to get in. His arm was grabbed by someone from behind. He was startled. When he turned around, it was still Zhou Jinyu.
I saw him treating himself and Yan as if nothing had happened.Yue Se, with a sincere tone: I was rude just now. Let's do this. You can call me when you get home, or you can send me a message. Do you think this is okay?
Seeing him like this, Xia Zhenyu couldn't be too hurtful, so he nodded and got into the car, told the address and the car drove away.
Zhou Jinyu stood there and watched the taxi leave. He memorized the license plate number and returned to the hotel.
When Xia Zhenyu arrived at home, Xia's mother said angrily: You are such an adult and you are so careless. Li Wei is on a business trip. You should pay more attention to your home keys. How can you leave your keys at work? Also, even if you go out with your colleagues, you can't go home so late. You won't be able to do this again, otherwise your mother-in-law will not be happy.
Xia Zhenyu coaxed her and said, "Aren't you so busy that you forgot about it?" Mom, Li Wei will be back on Monday. You are so unwilling for me to come back and live here.
Stop talking nonsense. If you feel tight, take a shower and go to bed. What time is it?
After persuading her mother to go back to the bedroom to rest, Xia Zhenyu simply washed up and went back to her room to lie down on the bed. After thinking about it, she decided to send a message to Zhou Jinyu. She was doing it for her own good, so she couldn't be too stubborn.
She only sent four words: I'm home. The other party quickly replied: OK, go to bed early.
Xia Zhenyu looked at the concise reply and really didn't understand such a simple thing. What was she and Zhou Jinyu arguing about just now? Although Li Wei's matter was still bothering her, she was really tired and fell asleep after a while.
Li Wei was nowhere to be seen for two days on the weekend, and Xia Zhenyu didn't want to alarm others, so she just let him go. When she went to work on Monday, she felt that the atmosphere was not right as soon as she entered the lobby. What can I say? Her colleagues still smiled and greeted her, but their eyes and attitudes were strange. What happened?
Just when she was about to ask Sister Wang, Director Zhu had already seen her and said to her with a smile: Xiaoxia, you came a little later than usual today. Is it difficult to get on the bus?
Good morning, Director Zhu, no, it’s because I haven’t been home for the past two days and I don’t have to catch the bus, so I didn’t go so early.
Xia Zhenyu didn't understand why after listening to his answer, Director Zhu's face smiled like a blooming chrysanthemum. He just heard him say again: Xiaoxia, your Jiayuan leaders all know it. If you are usually in a hurry, don't be anxious. Everyone can understand this kind of difficulty. Are you tired from work recently?
What's going on? Director Zhu is the most snobbish person. His eyes only look up but not down. This is very abnormal for him.
It's okay, Director Zhu. I'm used to getting up early. Thank you for your concern. I'm not tired at work and my colleagues are very kind. Xia Zhenyu chose the safest words.
Haha, that’s good, but if you really have any difficulties, don’t be polite to Big Brother. Whether it’s work or life, the organization will try its best to help you solve it. After saying that, he wanted to pat Xia Zhenyu on the shoulder, but when he reached out halfway, he turned back and touched his head. He smiled again and went upstairs.
laugh! Nothing has happened yet, people have started kowtowing to say hello before even crossing the road?
